svg.title: Example: Delivery Pipeline Canvas
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape board: seven pipeline stages from commit to monitoring, each with time, waits, failures, manual steps, gates, tools and owner; pipeline totals, bottlenecks, the next improvement, and signs of a healthy pipeline.
svg.text: Map how a change gets from a developer's commit to customers, find where it waits or fails, and pick the next fix.
Engineering Practices · Continuous Integration & Delivery · Inspired by Continuous Delivery (Humble & Farley)
